cases.prompt: Create three seamless parallax forest layers with a horizon-safe composition and a manifest for a side-scrolling game.
cases.rationale: The delivery contains one background family and needs layered-scene validation, not atlas or multi-family coordination.

cases.prompt: Necesito un panorama de arena de combate con primer plano, fondo y capa atmosférica, listo para desplazamiento horizontal.
cases.rationale: Es una sola familia de fondos con capas y scroll; no requiere el router de una entrega compuesta.

cases.prompt: Use Grok Imagine still generation for a full-bleed desert parallax scene, preserve the authored sky and terrain pixels, then verify composite and scroll behavior.
cases.rationale: Grok is the selected still provider, but the output remains one full-bleed background family whose proof is composite plus scroll.

cases.prompt: Build a raster game UI kit with idle, hover, pressed, disabled, and focus states plus nine-slice proof for every panel.
cases.rationale: The work is a single UI family whose critical contract is interaction-state and stretch validation.

cases.prompt: Entrega un kit HUD raster con iconos, cursores y paneles en dos densidades, incluyendo estados de interacción verificables.
cases.rationale: El pedido se limita a componentes raster de interfaz y necesita pruebas de estados y densidad.

cases.prompt: Generate a small button and toggle family with Grok Imagine on neutral gray, remove the matte without losing gray outlines, and prove states, alpha edges, densities, and nine-slice behavior.
cases.rationale: The explicit still provider does not change ownership: neutral cutout, states, density and stretch proof belong to the UI leaf.

cases.prompt: Create 24 non-animated pickup sprites with consistent pivots, transparent bounds, hashes, and a contact sheet.
cases.rationale: These are static gameplay objects, so pivot, sizing, provenance, and contact-sheet proof are the decisive checks.

cases.prompt: Genera un pack no animado de pociones, llaves y monedas con tamaños coherentes, licencias y manifiesto de exportación.
cases.rationale: Es una única familia de objetos estáticos y no contiene animación, fondos ni estados de interfaz.

cases.prompt: Use Imagegen to create isolated gray-metal pickups on a neutral white background, remove only the background without erasing subject neutrals, and deliver pivots, provenance, hashes, and alpha proof.
cases.rationale: This is one static family; provider-backed neutral cutout and contact proof are owned by the static asset skill.

cases.prompt: Turn six authored run-cycle frames into a packed sprite atlas and verify timing, frame order, pivots, and transparent padding.
cases.rationale: Animation frames and atlas assembly require the spritesheet pipeline rather than a static asset validator.

cases.prompt: Extrae y valida un tileset desde este atlas, detecta celdas, evita bleed entre vecinos y entrega pruebas de repetición.
cases.rationale: La extracción y QA de un atlas o tileset pertenece al pipeline especializado de spritesheets.

cases.prompt: Animate this approved first sprite frame with Grok Imagine, extract a stable loop from the video, align the frames, and deliver a verified spritesheet.
cases.rationale: The provider video is only a source; deterministic frame sampling, alignment, atlas composition, previews, and animation QA belong to the spritesheet pipeline.

cases.prompt: Generate a mascot sprite row with Imagegen on neutral gray, use model-backed background removal, align the extracted frames, and inspect playback, contact poses, onion skin, and alpha edges.
cases.rationale: A provider-generated animated row still needs the spritesheet extraction, registration, playback, onion and animation-contract gates.

cases.prompt: The generated greeting loop moves both feet across the floor; regenerate the semantic motion while locking pelvis and feet, then verify planted-leg metrics, onion overlays, and chronological playback.
cases.rationale: The failure is real lower-body motion, so it must return to semantic generation and then pass sprite-specific alignment and gesture gates.

cases.prompt: Assemble the already approved sprites, backgrounds, and UI into a store-art review board without modifying any source asset.
cases.rationale: The source assets already exist and the requested output is a non-destructive presentation derived from them.

cases.prompt: Compón una reconstrucción de gameplay para un pitch usando sólo assets aprobados, con hashes, etiquetas de verdad y procedencia.
cases.rationale: Se pide una composición de evidencia, no producir ni alterar familias de assets fuente.

cases.prompt: Deliver one coherent 2D game pack containing an animated hero, static props, parallax backgrounds, a UI kit, and a shared release manifest.
cases.rationale: Four coordinated production families need one router, shared style rules, owners, and a combined release manifest.

cases.prompt: Produce matching world pickups and inventory UI icons as one delivery with shared palette, naming, variants, and release ownership.
cases.rationale: The request crosses two production families and explicitly requires shared coordination, so a single leaf is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Deliver one release containing Imagegen character sprites, Grok still backgrounds, imported UI, and a truth-labelled review board with one shared style contract and verified provider provenance.
cases.rationale: Several producing families and a presentation must reconcile mixed providers, style, provenance, proof, ownership, and delivery hashes.

cases.prompt: Fix spacing, responsiveness, keyboard focus, and loading states in my existing React analytics dashboard.
cases.rationale: This is implementation work on an existing web interface, not production or composition of raster game assets.

cases.prompt: Model, rig, skin, and light a real-time 3D creature for Blender and export it as glTF.
cases.rationale: The target is a rigged 3D asset and falls outside every 2D raster production and presentation contract in this suite.
